sentences.text:
1 This present application has been filed on behalf of the petitioner for the following relief/s:-
"(i) To direct the respondent authority particularly respondent no. 8 and respondent no. 4 to investigate the Muffasil P.S case No. 344 of 2022 Patna High Court CR.

WJC No.903 of 2023(2) dt.10-04-2025 for the offence u/s 406, 420, 467, 468, 469, 471,
120(B) of the I.P.C properly in which till date police has taken no any action which is lodged by the petitioner and openly giving threatening and pressurizing to withdraw the case otherwise to face dire consequences.

(ii) To direct the respondent authority to secure the protection of life and limbs to the old petitioner who has always fear of her life from private respondent no. 9 to 14 who are giving threatening to kill him."
2. At the very outset, learned APP for the State has submitted that the investigation is pending and there is a civil dispute also.
3. The Police is directed to conclude the investigation within three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
4. So far as prayer nos. 1 & 2 are concerned, the petitioner is given liberty to approach the Superintendent of Police, Aurangabad for his security and protection.
5. Accordingly, this application is disposed of.

(Sandeep Kumar, J) Shishir/-
